_comment: Columns that genuinely do not exist. Each of these queries fails at runtime
and returns data: null — they are NOT false positives. They are listed
rather than fixed because the right replacement is a product decision.
Fixing one? Remove it here in the same change — check:columns fails on a
stale entry, so this list cannot rot into a permanent exemption.
journal_entries.rating        -> dropped; no consumer ever read it
plan-adherence.ts computes it from the checklist plus the trader's
playbook_review overrides, at a 100% threshold. Selecting the phantom
column had been failing the WHOLE select with 42703, which also took
out grade and left both the discipline and journal_score leaderboard
categories reading zero for every user.
The list is empty. That is the goal state — keep it that way.
